sentences.en: Local man Sandy McGregor's book " The Law Killers, " published September 2005, instantly became the No.1 bestseller in our store.

sentences.en: McGregor had moved to Birmingham to seek his fortune and opened a linen draper 's shop near Villa Park.

sentences.en: In 1997, McGregor created The Millennarium, a seventy minute vision of a futuristic dystopia.

sentences.en: The replay was looking to be heading the same way until the final seconds, when in-form striker McGregor slotted home.

sentences.en: Ben Maher, a Random dancer, whom McGregor also continues to commission, made the costumes for the entire trilogy.

sentences.en: He will star opposite Ewan McGregor in Woody Allen's latest untitled film.

sentences.en: At age 11, she played the character Ruthie in Tim Burton's 2003 film Big Fish, alongside veteran actors Ewan McGregor, Albert Finney, Billy Crudup, Robert Guilliaume and Jessica Lange.

sentences.en: McGregor Vineyard Winery - Located in Dundee, is known for its wide variety of grapes growing on the property.

sentences.en: Also laudable is the casting of Ewan McGregor as the young Obi-Wan Kenobi, and the creation of archetype Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, played as a noble rebel by Liam Neeson.

sentences.en: A stage and screen star popular for his romantic portrayals, Ewan McGregor is married to French production designer, Eve Mavrakis.
sentences.vi: Là một ngôi sao sân khấu và màn ảnh nổi tiếng với những vai diễn lãng mạn, Ewan McGregor đã kết hôn với nhà thiết kế sản xuất người Pháp, Eve Mavrakis.
